title: DevCompass project config
description: Schema for devcompass.config.json, a project-level config file for the devcompass CLI. Unknown keys are an error.

failOn.description: Policy gate used when `devcompass analyze` gets no --fail-on / --fail-on-license flag (a flag always wins).

severity.description: Exit 1 when any finding is at or above this severity; "kev" matches only vulnerabilities on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list.

licenses.description: SPDX license ids that fail the run when any installed package uses them, e.g. "AGPL-3.0" (also covers -only, -or-later and +). A package dual-licensed with an allowed alternative ("MIT OR GPL-3.0") passes.

ignore.description: Findings to suppress (removed before scoring and policy gates). Every entry needs a reason so accepted risks stay visible.

id.description: One specific finding id, as shown in `analyze --json`, e.g. "vuln:lodash@4.17.15:GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx".

rule.description: With "package": only findings of this type or rule id, e.g. "unused", "license", "outdated/major".

reason.description: Why this is an accepted risk. Required.

expires.description: ISO date after which this ignore stops applying and the finding comes back.

checks.description: Turn individual checks on or off. ecosystem and predictive are off by default (they call GitHub's API); the rest are on.
